gloss: inspection group; observation delegation; fact-finding mission

definitions.gloss: inspection group; observation delegation; fact-finding mission
definitions.explanation: An organized group sent to observe, inspect, or investigate a particular site, facility, project, or situation. Common in government, business, and international contexts.

examples.japanese: {視察団|しさつだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れた→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: The inspection group visited the factory.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧{視察団|しさつだん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦ヨーロッパ→ヨーロッパ：00427_yooroppa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was sent to Europe as part of an overseas inspection delegation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{議会|ぎかい}→議会：02661_gikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{視察団|しさつだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{復興|ふっこう}→復興：07590_fukkou⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: A parliamentary inspection delegation confirmed the recovery progress in the disaster-affected area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市長|しちょう}→市長：12472_shichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{団長|だんちょう}→団長：12162_danchou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{視察団|しさつだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{先進的|せんしんてき}→先進的：20024_senshinteki⟧な⟦{福祉|ふくし}{施設|しせつ}→福祉施設：24516_fukushishisetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An inspection delegation led by the mayor toured advanced welfare facilities.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{視察|しさつ}→視察：16562_shisatsu⟧ (inspection, observation) and ⟦{団|だん}→〜団：04663_dan⟧ (group, party). The suffix ～⟦{団|だん}→〜団：04663_dan⟧ forms organized groups: {調査団|ちょうさだん} (investigation team), {代表団|だいひょうだん} (delegation), {救助団|きゅうじょだん} (rescue team), etc.

{視察団|しさつだん} are typically official or semi-official, sent by governments, legislatures, companies, or professional organizations to observe best practices, assess conditions, or gather information for policy-making.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {視察団|しさつだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dispatch an inspection delegation
- {視察団|しさつだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れる→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧: to receive an inspection delegation
- ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧{視察団|しさつだん}: overseas observation delegation
- ⟦{議会|ぎかい}→議会：02661_gikai⟧{視察団|しさつだん}: parliamentary inspection delegation
- {視察団|しさつだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧: inspection delegation report

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {調査団|ちょうさだん}: investigation team — focuses on detailed research and data collection rather than observation
- {代表団|だいひょうだん}: delegation — a group representing an organization or country, not necessarily for inspection purposes
- {使節団|しせつだん}: mission, envoy group — a diplomatic delegation sent for negotiations or goodwill
